newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc rises further on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc rises further on rumours.

text.p: Shares in Rhone-Poulenc rose nearly four percent in early trading on Tuesday after a 2.78 percent advance on Monday, on continued rumours about a possible alliance or merger in the pharmaceutical sector.
"It's still the old rumour about a possible merger of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer," said a dealer.
At 0927 GMT, Rhone-Poulenc shares were up 3.9 percent at 173.1 francs.
Other traders noted broker Ferri hosted a meeting this morning on Rhone-Poulenc and said in a note that the share was undervalued.

A source close to the company told Reuters on Tuesday that the 1996 net attributable profit of the chemicals and pharmaceutical group should show a 20 to 25 percent rise from the 2.123 billion francs of 1995.
This is in line with analysts' forecasts of a figure of 2.686 billion francs.
Rhone had no comment ahead of its results on January 30.
